baseline_sql: SELECT u.user_id, ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount), 2) AS performance_metric FROM users AS u JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.city = '杭州' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date <= '2026-09-12' GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY performance_metric DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT 8
v1_1_sql: SELECT u.user_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM users AS u JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id WHERE u.city = '杭州' AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '30' DAY) GROUP BY u.user_id ORDER BY order_count DESC, u.user_id ASC LIMIT 8

question: 服饰鞋包近期批准了多少退款金额？只返回金额。
actual_clarification_question: 近期指最近几天？选项：3天、7天、30天。
baseline_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds AS r JOIN order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND p.category = '服饰鞋包' AND r.refund_date >= DATE_SUB('2026-09-12', INTERVAL '7' DAY) LIMIT 200
v1_1_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount), 2) AS refund_amount FROM refunds AS r JOIN order_items AS oi ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status = 'approved' AND p.category = '服饰鞋包' AND r.refund_date BETWEEN '2026-06-15' AND '2026-09-11' LIMIT 200
